researched.description: Data preparation, analytics automation, and AI workflow platform sold across all industries including public sector and higher education
researched.notes: Horizontal analytics platform - owner example of scope_review. Founded 1997 as SRC LLC, renamed Alteryx 2010; taken private by Clearlake/Insight 2024.

researched.description: Enrollment marketing, student success CRM, and institutional data software for colleges, universities, and school districts
researched.notes: Legal entity EAB Global, Inc. Founding year omitted: site says '40+ years' (traces to The Advisory Board Company, 1979) but EAB itself was formed as a division in 2007 and spun out independently in 2017 - sources conflict. Sells both software and advisory research; software is the larger, primary offering.

researched.description: Wi-Fi and sensor-driven space occupancy analytics for university campuses and corporate real estate teams
researched.notes: Formerly Armored Things; rebranded to Lambent in 2022. Sells to corporate campuses as well as higher ed - if the owner counts that as horizontal, this could be scope_review.

researched.description: Business intelligence, reporting, and analytics software sold to enterprises, government agencies, and universities
researched.notes: Formerly MicroStrategy; renamed Strategy in 2025. Horizontal BI product, same shape as the Alteryx example. Note the public company is now primarily a bitcoin treasury vehicle alongside the software business - strategy.com foregrounds MSTR bitcoin metrics.

researched.description: Transport coordination, volunteer, and foster management software for animal shelters and rescue organizations
researched.notes: Candidate had no URL; doobert.com confirmed via their About page (founders Chris and Rachael Roy, launched May 2014). Buyer base is mostly nonprofit rescue groups plus municipal shelters, so the government share is partial - worth a second look. Sector map has no animal-services category; filed under Citizen Services. HQ not found by these searches.

researched.description: Animal shelter and rescue management software covering intake, medical records, adoptions, and volunteers
researched.notes: Candidate had no URL; shelterluv.com confirmed. Site is a JS app that renders only 'Loading...' to fetch/curl, so the description rests on search-result and directory summaries rather than page text. HQ omitted: directories give Menlo Park CA, Palo Alto CA, Key Biscayne FL, and Roswell GA - not resolvable. Founding year 2012 is from Crunchbase/Tracxn-style profiles, not the company site. Sector map has no animal-services category.

researched.description: Capital improvement plan tracking, approval workflow, and reporting software for city and county finance departments
researched.notes: Judgment call: CodeRight's own homepage reads as a Microsoft Dynamics 365 / Power Platform consultancy, but CapitalPath Pro is a real named product built on that stack and sold to municipal finance directors - that product is what exhibited at GFOA. coderight.com redirects to capitalpathpro.com. HQ and founding year not found by these searches.

researched.description: Cashiering, remittance, and intelligent document capture software for tax, revenue, and motor vehicle agencies
researched.notes: Legal entity is Fairfax Imaging, Inc. d/b/a Fairfax Software; acquired by Embrace Software Inc. Also sells the same capture products to banks and insurers, but government revenue processing is the core market.

researched.description: Cloud utility billing, payments, and service order software for municipal water and wastewater utilities
researched.notes: Owned by Neptune Technology Group. Their own company page says only 'headquartered in central Pennsylvania'; Bellwood, PA comes from their own LinkedIn and Facebook listings. Founding year not stated on their site - omitted.

researched.description: Barcode inventory and warehouse management software extending Oracle NetSuite and Microsoft Dynamics ERP for distribution, manufacturing, and healthcare
researched.notes: A division of ICS (Integrated Custom Software). Horizontal ERP add-on - their own site names distribution, manufacturing, retail, and healthcare, not government; they exhibited at GFOA for public-sector ERP inventory. Founding year 1982 is from directory profiles, not their site.

researched.description: Enterprise software suite for local governments, utilities, and public agencies covering finance, asset and field management, workforce, and recreation
researched.notes: Roll-up of 70+ products across eight verticals (also nonprofit, manufacturing, media), but government and utilities are the core. Founding year 2019 is the holding company's own stated date; several of its products are far older.

researched.description: Employee performance review, goal tracking, and feedback software for HR teams
researched.notes: General HR performance-management software - their own Solutions page segments by industry, role, and company size with no public-sector emphasis, and their /government page is 'under construction'. Third-party writeups say local government is a target segment, which is presumably why they exhibited at PSHRA. HQ not stated on site (phone is a Utah 385 area code, not enough to place them); founding year not found.

researched.description: USDA-compliant menu planning, nutrient analysis, and menu publishing software for K-12 school nutrition departments
researched.notes: Operated by Water Walkers, Inc. Their About page says the business started as a consultancy (A Higher Level) and began selling software in 2012, with USDA approval in 2013 - 2012 is the software-launch year, not necessarily the entity's incorporation.

researched.description: Cafeteria point-of-sale, free and reduced meal eligibility, and claims reporting software for K-12 school nutrition programs
researched.notes: Their About page says '100% focused on student nutrition solutions. We service no other markets.' Founding year omitted: directory profiles list 1984 but their own site says only 'over 25 years' - not confirmed.

researched.description: Claimed IoT infrastructure monitoring data provider; company not confirmed
researched.notes: Not found by these searches. Candidate had no URL. Searched the exact name '"Dynamic IoT Data Inc"', the name plus NACE / county engineers / road weather sensors, and checked dynamic-iot.net and dynamicdata.com - all are different companies (an Akron OH IT services shop, a 2020 IoT analytics consultancy, a Parker CO IT reseller). Could not confirm this entity exists or what it sells. This is 'not found by these searches', not proof of nonexistence - an exhibitor list check would settle it.

researched.description: Cloud document and email management with legal AI for law firms, corporate legal departments, and government legal offices
researched.notes: Candidate had no URL; netdocuments.com confirmed. Judgment call for the owner: it is legal-vertical rather than truly horizontal, but its primary buyers are private law firms and corporate legal, with government legal (why it exhibited at IMLA, the municipal attorneys' association) as one segment among several - so not government-primary.

researched.description: Referral matching platform connecting Area Agency on Aging case managers to home and community-based service providers
researched.notes: Launch year 2021 comes from their USAging marketplace listing, not their own site. HQ not stated anywhere on the site; work shown is with CICOA in Indiana, but that is a customer, not proof of location - omitted rather than guessed.

researched.description: Continuous alcohol monitoring, GPS tracking, and supervision case management for courts, probation, and community corrections
researched.notes: Legal entity is Alcohol Monitoring Systems, Inc.; SCRAM Systems is the brand. Acquired by LMG Holdings in 2021. Hardware plus software, not software alone, but the monitoring platform is the offering agencies buy.

researched.description: Virtual supervision case management, client mobile app, and remote testing for pretrial, probation, parole, and specialty courts
researched.notes: Formerly Call2Test; registered as a public benefit corporation. Founding year 2009 is from CB Insights-style profiles, not their About page.

researched.description: Smartphone-based GPS, breathalyzer, and check-in monitoring for probation and pretrial supervision agencies
researched.notes: Legal name Outreach Smartphone Monitoring, LLC. Founding year omitted - the site says only 'Celebrating 10+ years in business' with no year given.

researched.description: Customer information, billing, financials, and work management software for municipal, cooperative, and investor-owned electric, water, gas, and fiber utilities
researched.notes: A division of N. Harris Computer Corporation (Constellation Software). Founding year not stated on their site. Sector map has no utility billing/CIS category - filed under Grid & Energy.

researched.description: AI platform that turns field crew video and voice into risk, safety, and productivity intelligence for utilities and infrastructure operators
researched.notes: BCG spinout; raised a $41M/GBP 32M Series B in 2026. Registered in England and Wales (Co. No. 12481168) with a Houston, TX US office. Named customers are UK utilities and contractors (Southern Water, SGN, Yorkshire Water, Ferrovial, Kier) - several are privately owned, so the government share of revenue is not clear-cut.

researched.description: SAMS environmental compliance platform for water, wastewater, stormwater, cross-connection, and air quality reporting at municipal utilities
researched.notes: Product is branded SAMS; the site brands both ways. Named customers include City of Phoenix and City of Peoria. Founding year omitted - their About page says only 'more than 15 years'.

researched.description: Customer self-service portals, mobile apps, and smart meter analytics for electric, water, gas, and multi-service utilities
researched.notes: Part of the Harris Utilities portfolio (N. Harris Computer / Constellation Software), same family as Cayenta. Sector map has no utility customer-portal category.

researched.description: Field data capture and asset inspection platform for industrial coatings, shipbuilding, pipeline, and energy construction compliance
researched.notes: Real product company, but their own site lists industries as coating inspection, infrastructure, marine, and oil and gas - not government. Navy shipbuilding compliance is the only public-sector-adjacent use named. Worth a look at whether this belongs in a SLED tracker at all. Founding year not found by these searches.

researched.description: ArcGIS geographic information system software, apps, and implementation for Canadian governments, utilities, schools, and public agencies
researched.notes: Judgment call worth a second look: Esri Canada is the exclusive Canadian distributor of Esri Inc.'s ArcGIS plus its own solutions, training, and services - the owner may prefer to treat it as a reseller/regional arm rather than an independent product card. Founding year 1984 is stated on their own homepage.

researched.description: Case management, enrollment, and outcomes reporting software for state and local workforce development, adult education, and apprenticeship programs
researched.notes: A product of Empyra.com, Inc., which describes itself as having 30+ years in software development and consulting. HQ not stated on the site or the About page - the founder is a Carnegie Mellon MSE alum, which hints at Pittsburgh but is not evidence, so omitted. Founding year not found by these searches.

researched.description: Data Station unemployment insurance benefits and tax system for state workforce agencies
researched.notes: Product company, not a consultancy - the platform ships regulatory updates as new UI programs are enacted. Founding year not disclosed on their site.

researched.description: HR and environmental health and safety compliance software, regulatory content, and training courseware for employers in all industries
researched.notes: Horizontal compliance vendor - their own site claims 34,000 companies across manufacturing, construction, healthcare, and retail, with public risk pools (why they exhibited at PRIMA) as one slice. Also part publisher: revenue mixes SaaS (EHS Hero, HR Hero, TrainingToday) with attorney-verified content subscriptions, so the owner may see it as more content than product. Formerly Business & Legal Resources / M. Lee Smith Publishers.

researched.description: Video playout servers, scheduling, live streaming, captioning, and audio description for government access channels, legislatures, and school districts
researched.notes: Named customers include Michigan State Senate, CAN TV Chicago, Seattle Public Schools, and Kern County Schools. Founding year 2007 is inferred from the site's '(c) 2007-2025' copyright range, not an explicit statement. Sells hardware playout servers alongside cloud software.
